_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

Assault the Arathi Basin mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
Find The Eye of Bhossca inside of the Scarlet Monastery. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
Find someone in Desolace who knows about the pillaged campsite.
Collect 5 Twisted Fire Totems, 5 Twisted Earth Totems, 5 Twisted Air Totems, and 5 Twisted Water Totems for Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.
Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.
Collect 5 Twisted Fire Totems, 5 Twisted Earth Totems, 5 Twisted Air Totems, and 5 Twisted Water Totems for Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
Speak with Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.
Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.

Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.
Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.
Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan and slay 6 Undead Ravagers, then return to Nerlokh at the southern entrance to Valley of Bones.
Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring 1 Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh at the entrance of the Valley of Bones.
Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring an Accursed Skull and Gelkis Necromantic Garb to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.
Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.
Use the items contained in the Entomology Starter Kit to find and catch an Arbor Tarantula, Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.
Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.
Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
Bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Umarak in the Desolace.
Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
Steal Barton's Scouting Report by pickpocketing it from him. Then, bring the report to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.
Steal a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor to infiltrate Stromgarde Keep.
While disguised as a member of the Syndicate, find someone inside Stromgarde Keep who knows about the secret deal.
Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
Collect 6 Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.
Defeat a variety of Hatefury satyr at Sargeron in Desolace and then return to Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village.
Speak with Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.
Recover 8 Stolen Shipments from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda in Stranglethorn Vale and return your haul to someone in Booty Bay.
Return 12 Surgical Spidersilk to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall, Arathi Highlands.
Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.
Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.
